title: 7 Marks of the Brothers a Godly Man Actually Keeps Close
caption:
7 marks of the brothers a godly man actually keeps close.

(Not the ones who just like the posts.)

They know his number before he tells them the story. They've seen him at his worst and stayed anyway. They tell him the truth even when it costs the friendship.

As iron sharpens iron, one man sharpens another (Proverbs 27:17). Twelve guys who like his posts can't do what two guys who have his number can.
